description: Stability Aware Energy System Optimization Models - PowerModels.jl Extension (PowerModelsSTAWESOM) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Universität Stuttgart. Extensions of the Julia-based OPF framework PowerModels.jl to enable the formulation of generation expansions planning problems with a high degree of flexibility in mathematical formulations. Additionally offers inertia/RoCoF constraints for UC and GEP as described in. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Optimization, Power System Dynamics, Generation Expansion Planning. Software: PowerModels.jl; JuMP; Julia 1.11. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
